title: Product-Led Growth, Activation, and Time-to-Value
content:
Demo source notes — original paraphrase, not a verbatim transcript.

Product-led growth depends on the product helping users experience meaningful value. A free plan alone is not enough; teams should examine whether new users can reach an important outcome quickly.

Activation should represent a behavior that is meaningfully connected to future retention. Onboarding should reduce the distance between signup and first value rather than attempt to teach every feature.

Growth experiments are stronger when tied to a specific stage of the user journey, a hypothesized mechanism, and a measurable outcome. Retention ultimately depends on recurring value, so teams should understand the recurring job or habit that gives users a reason to return.
